sources.entry: Stik - Quick-capture markdown notes app with hotkeys and AI semantic search. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/0xMassi/stik_app) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Stik - Instant thought capture for macOS. Global hotkey summons a post-it note, type and close. Notes stored as plain markdown files.

summary.one_liner: Stik is a macOS quick-capture app that summons a floating post-it note via a global hotkey, saving each note as a plain markdown file.
summary.what_it_does: Pressing a global shortcut (Cmd+Shift+S) opens a floating post-it over whatever app you are using, where you type a note and close it. Notes are saved as markdown files in ~/Documents/Stik/. Other capabilities in the README include voice dictation via WhisperKit, appending selected text from any app to a Clips note (Cmd+Shift+C), folders, a command palette, pinned desktop sticky notes, and a source-mode markdown editor with wiki-links and slash commands. Notes can be encrypted with AES-256 and unlocked with Touch ID or a device password. On-device semantic search uses Apple's NaturalLanguage framework. Sync is handled by pointing the app at iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Syncthing, or a git remote.
use_cases: Capture quick thoughts without leaving the current app
Keep plain markdown notes readable in any editor
Dictate notes by voice on a Mac
Collect selected text from browsers and editors into one note
Search personal notes semantically without cloud services
Sync notes across Macs through iCloud Drive or Dropbox
how_to_run: Or download the .dmg from stik.ink/download or the GitHub Releases page
notable: Global hotkey summons a post-it note over any app, meant for capture in under a few seconds
Notes are plain .md files in ~/Documents/Stik/, with no account or cloud service required
On-device AI and voice transcription run locally via Apple frameworks
Clips shortcut appends selected text from any app without copy and paste
Available in English and Simplified Chinese, with a documented translation workflow
caveats: Requires macOS 14+ (Sonoma) and Accessibility permission for global shortcuts
Build from source needs Xcode Command Line Tools, Rust, Node.js 20+, and Bun 1.4.1
Anonymous analytics exist but are off by default
